notebooks.description: Multi-sensor data audit, L&S band Level-0A PDS4 ingestion, LOLA topography, and analysis-ready coregistration
DFSAR radar polarimetry ice detection, Level-0A telemetry audit, CPR/DOP availability notice, PSR cold-trap coupling, slope roughness discrimination, and exploration confidence tiering
